easy: Doing something that breaks a rule or someone's rights.

ex.en: Talking during the test is a violation of the class rules.
ex.ko: 시험 중에 떠드는 것은 교실 규칙 위반이다.

easy: A small flat case you keep in your pocket for money and cards.

ex.en: I put my allowance in my wallet.

easy: A room where people make or fix things with their hands.

ex.en: Grandpa builds wooden toys in his workshop.

easy: A short class where a small group learns by doing things together.

ex.en: I joined a drawing workshop at the library.
ex.ko: 나는 도서관에서 열린 그림 워크숍에 참가했다.

easy: Covered in paper so you cannot see what is inside.

ex.en: The wrapped present was under the tree.

easy: On a ship, train, or plane.

ex.en: All the kids were aboard the bus.

easy: The special way a person talks, based on where they come from.

ex.en: My cousin from Texas has a funny accent.

easy: Not sleeping.

ex.en: I stayed awake to watch the stars.

easy: Empty, with nothing written or drawn on it.

ex.en: Draw a picture on the blank page.

easy: Showing that you do not understand.

ex.en: He gave me a blank look when I asked the question.
ex.ko: 내가 질문하자 그는 멍한 표정을 지었다.

easy: A big brown animal with shaggy hair that lives on the plains of North America.

ex.en: We saw a buffalo eating grass at the park.
ex.ko: 우리는 공원에서 풀을 먹는 들소를 보았다.

easy: A big animal like a cow with wide horns, found in Asia and Africa.

ex.en: The farmer's buffalo walked through the muddy field.

easy: A very strong belief that you are sure is true.

ex.en: She has a strong conviction that kindness matters.
ex.ko: 그녀는 친절이 중요하다는 굳은 신념이 있다.

easy: Not honest; doing wrong things to get money or power.

ex.en: In the story, the corrupt king took money from poor people.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 부패한 왕은 가난한 사람들의 돈을 빼앗았다.

easy: Full of mistakes because it was damaged or copied wrong.

ex.en: My computer file is corrupt, so it will not open.
ex.ko: 내 컴퓨터 파일이 손상되어 열리지 않는다.

easy: A big farm animal that gives us milk.

ex.en: The cow gave milk every morning.

easy: A line that bends smoothly instead of going straight.

ex.en: Draw a curve like a rainbow.

easy: A line on a graph that shows how numbers change.

ex.en: The curve on the graph goes up every month.

easy: A baseball pitch that bends as it flies toward the batter.

ex.en: The pitcher threw a curve, and I swung and missed.
ex.ko: 투수가 커브를 던졌고 나는 헛스윙을 했다.

easy: Earned because you did something good.

ex.en: She got a deserved prize after months of practice.
ex.ko: 그녀는 몇 달 연습한 끝에 받을 만한 상을 받았다.

easy: Eating a meal, usually in the evening.

ex.en: Dining out with my family is fun.

easy: How long something lasts.

ex.en: The duration of the movie is two hours.
ex.ko: 그 영화의 상영 시간은 두 시간이다.

easy: How long something goes on.

ex.en: The rain was short in duration.

easy: Giving you hope or courage.

ex.en: My coach said encouraging words after the game.
ex.ko: 코치님은 경기 후 격려하는 말을 해 주셨다.

easy: One more than fourteen.

ex.en: My sister is fifteen years old.

easy: The number 15, which is fourteen plus one.

ex.en: Fifteen is my lucky number.

easy: Marked with little lines to show amounts.

ex.en: I measured water with a graduated cup.
ex.ko: 나는 눈금이 있는 컵으로 물을 쟀다.

easy: Your mom's or dad's mother.

ex.en: My grandmother bakes cookies with me.
ex.ko: 할머니는 나와 함께 쿠키를 구워 주신다.

easy: Very hard and unpleasant to live in.

ex.en: Winter in the far north is cold and harsh.

easy: Loud and rough to hear, not pleasant.

ex.en: The crow made a harsh cry.

easy: A high place.

ex.en: We climbed to the heights of the mountain and saw the lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 산의 높은 곳에 올라가 호수를 보았다.

easy: When you need to go fast because time is short.

ex.en: I was in a hurry to catch the school bus.

easy: Going so fast that you may make mistakes.

ex.en: In her hurry, she forgot her lunch box.

easy: Having to do with the body fighting germs.

ex.en: Your immune system fights germs.

easy: Not able to catch a sickness because your body can fight it.

ex.en: I had chickenpox, so now I am immune to it.
ex.ko: 나는 수두를 앓았기 때문에 이제 수두에 면역이 있다.

easy: When prices keep going up and money buys less.

ex.en: Because of inflation, candy costs more than last year.

easy: A careful check to see that things are okay.

ex.en: Our school kitchen passed the health inspection.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 주방은 위생 검사를 통과했다.

easy: To put something in place so it is ready to use.

ex.en: Dad will install a new light in my room.
ex.ko: 아빠가 내 방에 새 전등을 설치해 주실 것이다.

easy: To officially put someone in a new job.

ex.en: The new class president was installed at the school meeting.
ex.ko: 새 학급 회장이 학교 모임에서 취임했다.

easy: Words that tell you how to do something.

ex.en: I followed the instruction on the box to bake the cake.
ex.ko: 나는 상자에 적힌 설명대로 케이크를 구웠다.

easy: How strong something is.

ex.en: The intensity of the storm scared the puppy.

easy: How loud a sound is.

ex.en: The intensity of the thunder shook the windows.

easy: A list of everything a store has.

ex.en: The shop counted its inventory of toys.

easy: A request asking you to come to something.

ex.en: I got an invitation to Emma's birthday party.
ex.ko: 나는 엠마의 생일 파티 초대장을 받았다.

easy: About courts and judges.

ex.en: Judges and courts are part of the judicial system.

easy: To bend your body or tilt to one side.

ex.en: I lean over the fence to pet the horse.
ex.ko: 나는 울타리 너머로 몸을 숙여 말을 쓰다듬는다.

easy: To put something against another thing so it rests there.

ex.en: I lean my bike against the wall.

easy: A talk given to many people to teach them about something.

ex.en: We went to a lecture about space at the museum.
ex.ko: 우리는 박물관에서 우주에 관한 강연을 들으러 갔다.

easy: A long talk when someone tells you that you did something wrong.

ex.en: I got a lecture from Mom about cleaning my room.
ex.ko: 나는 엄마에게 방 청소에 대한 잔소리를 들었다.

easy: Teaching by talking to a class.

ex.en: The lecture lasted an hour.

easy: A worker who builds with stone or bricks.

ex.en: The mason built a stone wall around the garden.

easy: Important and having a good reason or purpose.

ex.en: Grandma's letter was meaningful to me.

easy: Wanting to do something and working hard at it.

ex.en: I felt motivated to practice piano after the concert.
ex.ko: 연주회를 본 뒤 피아노를 연습할 의욕이 생겼다.

easy: The direction between north and west.

ex.en: The wind came from the northwest.

easy: The upper left part of a place on a map.

ex.en: It rains often in the northwest of the country.
ex.ko: 그 나라의 북서부에는 비가 자주 온다.

easy: Walking around an area again and again to keep it safe.

ex.en: A police officer on patrol waved at us.
ex.ko: 순찰 중인 경찰관이 우리에게 손을 흔들었다.

easy: A small, round, shiny white jewel that grows inside an oyster.

ex.en: Grandma wears a pearl necklace.

easy: A plant that grows red, green, or yellow vegetables, some sweet and some hot.

ex.en: We grow a pepper plant in our garden.

easy: A hot-tasting powder you sprinkle on food.

ex.en: Dad added salt and pepper to the eggs.

easy: A farm animal with a curly tail and a flat nose.

ex.en: The pig rolled in the mud.

easy: Many things put on top of each other.

ex.en: There is a pile of leaves in our yard.

easy: Something that fits in a hole to block it.

ex.en: Pull the plug and the sink water goes down.

easy: Giving people what they need.

ex.en: The provision of free books helped every student.
ex.ko: 무료 책 제공은 모든 학생에게 도움이 되었다.

easy: Changed to make better or more up to date.

ex.en: I turned in my revised story.

easy: A long, thin stick of metal or wood.

ex.en: Dad hung the curtain on a metal rod.

easy: A loud, high cry.

ex.en: We heard a scream on the roller coaster.

easy: A high, sharp sound that hurts your ears.

ex.en: The scream of the brakes hurt my ears.

easy: About numbers collected to learn facts.

ex.en: Our class made a statistical chart of favorite pets.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 좋아하는 반려동물에 대한 통계 도표를 만들었다.

easy: Salty water that comes out of your skin when you are hot.

ex.en: Sweat ran down my face after soccer.
ex.ko: 축구를 하고 나니 얼굴에 땀이 흘렀다.

easy: A picture drawn on the skin that stays forever.

ex.en: My uncle has a small anchor tattoo on his arm.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 팔에 작은 닻 문신이 있다.

easy: A sad play or story where bad things happen to the main person.

ex.en: We watched a tragedy at school and some kids cried.
ex.ko: 우리는 학교에서 비극 연극을 봤고 몇몇 아이들은 울었다.

easy: A sport where two people try to push each other to the floor.

ex.en: My brother joined the wrestling team.

easy: A place where people go to see wild animals.

ex.en: We saw giraffes at the zoo.

easy: To get something for yourself.

ex.en: She acquired a pet rabbit last spring.

easy: Someone who works hard to change things they think are unfair.

ex.en: The activist asked people to keep the river clean.
ex.ko: 그 활동가는 사람들에게 강을 깨끗이 지키자고 부탁했다.

easy: In the same way for both.

ex.en: Kids and parents alike loved the show.
ex.ko: 아이들과 부모님 모두 그 쇼를 좋아했다.

easy: In the same way.

ex.en: The twins dress alike.

easy: Almost the same.

ex.en: My sister and I look alike.

easy: Fitting or useful in a certain case.

ex.en: This rule is applicable to everyone in class.

easy: A sign shaped like an arrow that shows which way to go.

ex.en: Follow the arrow to find the exit.

easy: A thin stick with a sharp point that you shoot from a bow.

ex.en: The archer pulled back the string and shot an arrow.

easy: To curve instead of staying straight.

ex.en: The branch will bend in the wind.

easy: To turn and go in a new direction.

ex.en: The path bends to the left near the pond.

easy: To make something curved or crooked.

ex.en: Don't bend the pages of the book.

easy: A box with bars or wire to keep birds or animals in.

ex.en: The hamster ran in its cage.

easy: A small space for storing things.

ex.en: I hung my coat in the closet.

easy: A tall cabinet for hanging clothes.

ex.en: My shirts hang in the closet.

easy: Being awake and knowing what is around you.

ex.en: He lost consciousness for a moment after he fell.
ex.ko: 그는 넘어진 뒤 잠깐 의식을 잃었다.

easy: A person who knows a lot and gives advice.

ex.en: The school asked a reading consultant for help.
ex.ko: 학교는 독서 전문 자문 위원에게 도움을 청했다.

easy: A thing you use to control a machine or a game.

ex.en: I held the game controller in both hands.
ex.ko: 나는 두 손으로 게임 컨트롤러를 잡았다.

easy: Matching or going together.

ex.en: Match each letter to its corresponding number.
ex.ko: 각 글자를 그에 해당하는 숫자와 짝지어 보렴.

easy: A kind and polite thing you do for someone.

ex.en: Holding the door open is a courtesy.
ex.ko: 문을 잡아 주는 것은 예의 바른 행동이다.

easy: Being polite to other people.

ex.en: She treats everyone with courtesy.

easy: Needing a lot of effort and skill.

ex.en: Training for the big race was demanding.
ex.ko: 큰 경주를 위한 훈련은 아주 힘들었다.

easy: A flat round thing that plays music.

ex.en: Grandpa put a disc on the record player.

easy: A flat, round shape like a plate.

ex.en: The full moon looked like a bright disc.

easy: A big bird with strong wings that hunts other animals.

ex.en: An eagle soared above the mountain.

easy: A building where people from another country work to help their own country.

ex.en: My aunt visited the Korean embassy in Washington.
ex.ko: 이모는 워싱턴에 있는 한국 대사관을 방문했다.

easy: Interesting and fun, so you like it.

ex.en: The teacher told an engaging story.

easy: So interesting that you cannot stop watching or thinking about it.

ex.en: The book about sharks is fascinating.

easy: So lovely or amazing that you cannot look away.

ex.en: The magician's fascinating trick amazed us.
ex.ko: 마술사의 매혹적인 마술에 우리는 깜짝 놀랐다.

easy: Made to fit your size and shape.

ex.en: She wore a fitted jacket.
ex.ko: 그녀는 몸에 꼭 맞는 재킷을 입었다.

easy: Being kind and doing the right thing.

ex.en: Everyone saw her goodness when she helped the lost boy.
ex.ko: 그녀가 길 잃은 소년을 도왔을 때 모두가 그녀의 선함을 보았다.
